description: Create a short link (s.gooo.name) for an HTTP or HTTPS URL (compatible with shorten_url). Use when the user explicitly requests URL shortening, custom short codes, password protection, or link tagging. Automatically associates the link with the user's account when authenticated.

channel.description: Optional AI client identifier (e.g., chatgpt, codex, gemini, cursor, claude)

custom_code.description: Optional custom short code (at least 5 alphanumeric, hyphen, or underscore characters, e.g., my-doc)

password.description: Optional password to protect the short link upon redirect

session_id.description: Optional session identifier when not using OAuth Bearer token

url.description: Target HTTP or HTTPS URL to shorten (e.g., https://github.com/openai/openai-node)

name: create_short_url

is_custom.description: Whether a custom code was used

title: Create Short URL
